messages:
nina (Product): Quick mid-quarter check — can folks drop a 1-line update for their OKR milestones this sprint (shipped / slipped / blockers / next steps). I’ll roll into Friday slides. @eng-runtime @eng-platform

kevin (Eng Runtime): Shipped: runtime v2 autoscale bugfix + canary passed.
Slipped: quantization tweak for 8-bit perf (moved to next sprint).
Blocker: dedicated infra quota for integration tests (need more GPUs).
Next: pinging finance/ops for quota increase, canary stays live. :thumbsup:

mike-ops: noted — filing request with finance now, cc @kevin. ETA for approval depends on current quarter spend.

claudia (Product): Model routing OKR — Shipped: policy rollout A to 60% traffic.
Slipped: routing docs + e2e test coverage (docs lagging).
Blocker: API contract change from infra required for feature parity. @raj can you confirm timing?

raj (Eng Infra): I can pick up the API contract PR tomorrow, aiming to have a draft by Thu. Main risk is a dependent UI tweak from design.

alex (Design): UI tweak is in review, small CSS + copy change. If review passes today I can merge Wed morning.

sam (Eng SRE): FYI — saw a small latency bump in dedup cache tests after the autoscale patch, tracking in #incidents (ticket 4321). Not blocking the policy rollout but worth watching.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment runtime-v2/2026-03-18 completed to canary nodes (7/7 healthy). Logs: /deploys/runtime-v2/3510004321

kevin (Eng Runtime): @sam thanks — can you paste the perf diff when you have a sec? I want to correlate with batching config.

sam (Eng SRE): Will do — sending short perf snippet later today.

nina (Product): Thanks all. Owners list for slide bullets: Runtime autoscale — kevin; Model routing API — raj + alex; Docs/e2e — claudia (product) + eng-qe. If anyone needs extra canary time or a rollback plan, ping me.

claudia (Product): Quick ask — can owners confirm if any of the slipped items push downstream OKRs? I’ll mark dependencies on the tracker.

raj (Eng Infra): API PR timeline (Thu) shouldn't affect downstream ship dates unless design review slips.

alex (Design): If the review passes today, no downstream impact. If it slips, we may need to move docs by one sprint.

mike-ops: Finance replied — provisional approval for 2 additional GPU nodes pending justification doc. Kevin, can you drop a short cost blurb?

kevin (Eng Runtime): Dropping numbers now: extra 2 nodes (~$3.6k/mo), justification: full-integration test coverage + dedicated canary runs. Sending to ops.

nina (Product): Perfect. I’ll capture these as action items: 1) kevin send cost blurb (done) 2) raj PR by Thu 3) alex merge UI Wed 4) sam post perf diff 5) claudia confirm downstream impact. Folks — please update the tracker by EOD. :sparkles:

sam (Eng SRE): posted perf diff in the thread and linked the incident ticket.

claudia (Product): Updated tracker: marked docs as slipped -> next sprint, added dependency on design merge.

nina (Product): Great. If there are no more blockers, I’ll close this thread and include bullets in Friday slides. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
